```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(questionr)

```

# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

```{r}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

I2_A0 <- haven::read_sas("data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_sc_02_int_02.sas7bdat")

M2_C1_bornes0 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M2_C1_bornes0.csv",
                                show_col_types = F)

```

## Garder colonnes module

```{r}
change_it <- I2_A0 %>% 
    select(starts_with("it_")) %>% 
    colnames()

# Ajouter id_doublon
I2_A1 <- I2_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
    select(-c(id_date_creation:ps_debut_autre), -c(ps_redoubl:sc_int_cat), -int_type) %>%
    rename_with(~ gsub("^it", "sc_int", .x), any_of(change_it)) %>% 
    rename(
        "sc_int_date_creation" = "int_date_creation",
        "sc_int_repr_classe" = "sc_int_classe_repr",
        "sc_int_repr_classe_autre" = "sc_int_classe_repr_autre",
        "sc_int_repr_classe_cat" = "sc_int_classerepr_cat",
        "sc_int_repr_mois" = "sc_int_mois_repr",
        "sc_int_repr_an" = "sc_int_an_repr",
        "sc_int_duree_cat" = "sc_int_interromp_duree"
    ) %>% 
        relocate(
            c("ps_interromp", "int_ps_interromp", "sc_int_classe", "sc_int_classe_autre", "sc_int_classe_cat", "sc_int_mois",
            "sc_int_an", "sc_int_cause_1", "sc_int_cause_2", "sc_int_cause_3", "sc_int_cause_4", "sc_int_cause_999",
            "sc_int_cause_autre", "sc_int_repr", "sc_int_repr_classe", "sc_int_repr_classe_autre", "sc_int_repr_classe_cat",
            "sc_int_repr_mois", "sc_int_repr_an", "sc_int_duree_cat", "sc_int_duree_j"), .after = sc_int_date_creation
        )

rm(change_it)
```

## Identifier les absents

```{r}

vars_check <- I2_A1 %>%
  select(sc_int_classe:sc_int_non_repr) %>%
  colnames()

I2_A2 <- I2_A1 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    sc_it_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

## Retirer les doublons

```{r}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons_1 <- I2_A2 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(any(id_anonymat == id_doublon)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  # Ajouter variable pour identifier doublons et permettre d'ordonner les lignes
  
  mutate(
    is_og = if_else(
      id_anonymat == id_doublon, 0, 1
    ),
    .after = sc_int_date_creation
  ) %>% 
  
  arrange(id_keep, is_og, sc_int_classe, sc_int_an) %>% 
    relocate(
            c("ps_interromp", "int_ps_interromp", "sc_int_classe_autre"), .after = last_col()
        ) %>% 
            relocate(id_anonymat, .after = id_keep)
  

# Garder que les lignes différentes ------------------------------------------------

vars_verif <- doublons_1 %>% 
    select(sc_int_classe:sc_int_an, sc_int_repr:sc_int_non_repr) %>% 
    colnames()

# REPRENDRE ICI, DÉDOUBLONNER LA BASE DES INTERRUPTIONS

doublons_2 <- doublons_1 %>% 
  filter_out(is.na(sc_int_date_creation)) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  
  # Retirer les lignes pareilles
  distinct(
    pick(all_of(vars_verif)),
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      n = n(),
      .after = is_og
    ) %>% 
      ungroup()

clean <- doublons_2 %>% 
  filter(n == 1)

doublons_3 <- doublons_2 %>% 
  filter(!id_keep %in% clean$id_keep) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep, sc_int_date_creation) %>% 
  mutate(
    n_par_quest = n(),
    .after = n
  ) %>% 
    relocate(c("sc_int_repr_mois", "sc_int_repr_an"), .after = sc_int_an)

doublons_4 <- doublons_3 %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter_out(
    id_anonymat == "WYONK"
  ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(c("sc_int_cause_1", "sc_int_cause_999", "sc_int_cause_autre"), 
      ~ replace_when(
        .x,
        is.na(.x) & id_anonymat == "WCNVO" & sc_int_an == 2010 ~ vctrs::vec_fill_missing(.x, direction = "up")
      ))
    ) %>% 
      filter_out(id_anonymat == "YASAA") %>% 
      select(-n_par_quest)

doublons_corr <- bind_rows(
  clean,
  doublons_4
) %>% 
  select(-n) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  )

# Joindre les données propres
I2_B0 <- I2_A2 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons_1$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat, sc_int_classe, sc_int_an, sc_int_mois)

rm(list = c("doublons_1", "doublons_2", "doublons_3", "doublons_4", "clean", 
            "doublons_corr", "vars_verif"))

```
